caption:
4 everyday work tasks you can hand to AI today.

1. Write emails faster
2. Summarize long documents
3. Plan meetings
4. Draft social media posts

Try them with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot. Which one will you try first? Tell us in the comments.

Follow AI For Business for a new practical AI tip every day.

scenes.title: 4 Work Tasks to Give AI Today
Write emails faster
scenes.how: Give AI your key points. Ask for a short, polite email.

scenes.title: Summarize long documents
scenes.how: Paste the report. Ask for the 5 most important points.

scenes.title: Plan your meetings
scenes.how: Share the topics. Ask for an agenda with time for each item.

scenes.title: Draft social media posts
scenes.how: Describe your product. Ask for 3 caption ideas.
